tasks.price_basis: Casting directors bill flat project fees, so the per-role price is derived by dividing published project fees by typical principal role counts. Indie short $1,500 to $4,000 (Need a Crew, Filmcane) over 4 to 8 principal roles gives about $250 to $800 per role (low and base); indie feature under $1M at $5,000 to $10,000 over 8 to 15 roles gives $400 to $1,250; high is a single-location commercial at $2,500 to $7,500 over 2 to 5 roles or a complex role needing multiple sessions, capped at $1,500. Cross-check: a casting associate day rate of $400 to $800 for one day of sifting and session prep per role. Human minutes assume about 8 hours per principal role across breakdown, submissions review and session prep
